name.title: Name
name.description: You shouldn't need to change this.

hideTemperatureSensor.title: Hide Fan Temperature Sensor
hideTemperatureSensor.description: Enable this option to hide the temperature sensor.

temperatureOffset.title: Fan Temperature Offset
temperatureOffset.description: Subtract (or add) a set amount from the temperature reading (use negative numbers to subtract). This setting only applies to fans.

exposeOscillationSwitch.title: Expose Oscillation as a Switch
exposeOscillationSwitch.description: Expose fan oscillation as an additional switch for Home clients that do not display Fanv2 Swing Mode.

exposeAdvancedFanControls.title: Expose Advanced Fan Controls
exposeAdvancedFanControls.description: Expose supported Dreo fan modes and preferences as separate, clearly named switch accessories. Leave disabled for the clean native HomeKit fan interface.

exposeFanModeSwitches.title: Expose Named Fan Modes
exposeFanModeSwitches.description: Legacy advanced option: expose only Normal, Natural, Sleep, and Auto as separate mutually synchronized switches.

exposeFanPreferences.title: Expose Fan Preferences
exposeFanPreferences.description: Legacy advanced option: expose only supported Dreo preferences, such as Display Auto Off and Panel Sound, as separate switches.
